versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֡י בִּימֵ֣י אָ֠חָז בֶּן־יוֹתָ֨ם בֶּן־עֻזִּיָּ֜הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה עָלָ֣ה רְצִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־אֲ֠רָם וּפֶ֨קַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עָלֶ֑יהָ וְלֹ֥א יָכֹ֖ל לְהִלָּחֵ֥ם עָלֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
controles.livre: Sucedeu, pois, nos dias de Acaz, filho de Jotão, filho de Uzias, rei de Judá, que, Rezim, rei da Síria, e Peca, filho de Remalias, rei de Israel, subiram a Jerusalém para fazerem guerra contra ela; mas não conseguiram vencer a batalha contra ela.

versos.hebraico: וַיֻּגַּ֗ד לְבֵ֤ית דָּוִד֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר נָ֥חָֽה אֲרָ֖ם עַל־אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיָּ֤נַע לְבָבוֹ֙ וּלְבַ֣ב עַמּ֔וֹ כְּנ֥וֹעַ עֲצֵי־יַ֖עַר מִפְּנֵי־רֽוּחַ׃

controles.web: It was told the house of David, saying, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.
controles.kjv: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.
controles.livre: E avisaram à casa de Davi, dizendo: Os sírios se aliaram aos de Efraim. Então o coração dele se agitou, e também o coração de seu povo, tal como as árvores do bosque que se agitam com o vento.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶֽל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ֒ צֵא־נָא֙ לִקְרַ֣את אָחָ֔ז אַתָּ֕ה וּשְׁאָ֖ר יָשׁ֣וּב בְּנֶ֑ךָ אֶל־קְצֵ֗ה תְּעָלַת֙ הַבְּרֵכָ֣ה הָעֶלְיוֹנָ֔ה אֶל־מְסִלַּ֖ת שְׂדֵ֥ה כוֹבֵֽס׃

controles.web: Then Yahweh said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.
controles.kjv: Then said the Lord unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shear–jashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field;
controles.livre: Então o SENHOR disse a Isaías: Agora tu e teu filho Sear-Jasube, saí ao encontro de Acaz, ao final do aqueduto do tanque superior, na estrada do campo do lavandeiro.

versos.hebraico: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵ֠לָיו הִשָּׁמֵ֨ר וְהַשְׁקֵ֜ט אַל־תִּירָ֗א וּלְבָבְךָ֙ אַל־יֵרַ֔ךְ מִשְּׁנֵ֨י זַנְב֧וֹת הָאוּדִ֛ים הָעֲשֵׁנִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה בָּחֳרִי־אַ֛ף רְצִ֥ין וַאֲרָ֖ם וּבֶן־רְמַלְיָֽהוּ׃

controles.web: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
controles.kjv: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
controles.livre: E dize-lhe: Tem cuidado, mas fica calmo; não temas, nem desanime teu coração por causa dessas duas pontas fumegantes de lenha, por causa do ardor da ira de Rezim, dos sírios, e do filho de Remalias.

versos.hebraico: יַ֗עַן כִּֽי־יָעַ֥ץ עָלֶ֛יךָ אֲרָ֖ם רָעָ֑ה אֶפְרַ֥יִם וּבֶן־רְמַלְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,
controles.kjv: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,
controles.livre: Pois o sírio teve maligno conselho contra ti, com Efraim e com o filho de Remalias, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: נַעֲלֶ֤ה בִֽיהוּדָה֙ וּנְקִיצֶ֔נָּה וְנַבְקִעֶ֖נָּה אֵלֵ֑ינוּ וְנַמְלִ֥יךְ מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ אֵ֖ת בֶּן־טָֽבְאַֽל׃ס

controles.web: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king in its midst, even the son of Tabeel.”
controles.kjv: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:
controles.livre: Vamos subir contra Judá, e o aflijamos, e o repartamos entre nós; e façamos reinar como rei no meio dele ao filho de Tabeal.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה לֹ֥א תָק֖וּם וְלֹ֥א תִֽהְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: This is what the Lord Yahweh says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord God, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
controles.livre: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Isso não subsistirá, nem sucederá.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י רֹ֤אשׁ אֲרָם֙ דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְרֹ֥אשׁ דַּמֶּ֖שֶׂק רְצִ֑ין וּבְע֗וֹד שִׁשִּׁ֤ים וְחָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה יֵחַ֥ת אֶפְרַ֖יִם מֵעָֽם׃

controles.web: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people;
controles.kjv: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.
controles.livre: Pois a cabeça da Síria é Damasco, e o cabeça de Damasco Rezim; e dentro de sessenta e cinco anos Efraim será quebrado, e não será mais povo.

versos.hebraico: וְרֹ֤אשׁ אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וְרֹ֥אשׁ שֹׁמְר֖וֹן בֶּן־רְמַלְיָ֑הוּ אִ֚ם לֹ֣א תַאֲמִ֔ינוּ כִּ֖י לֹ֥א תֵאָמֵֽנוּ׃ס

controles.web: and the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”
controles.kjv: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.
controles.livre: E a cabeça de Efraim é Samaria, e o cabeça de Samaria é o filho de Remalias. Se não crerdes, não ficareis firmes.

versos.hebraico: וַיּ֣וֹסֶף יְהוָ֔ה דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶל־אָחָ֖ז לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke again to Ahaz, saying,
controles.kjv: Moreover the Lord spake again unto Ahaz, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR continuou a falar a Acaz, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: שְׁאַל־לְךָ֣ א֔וֹת מֵעִ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ הַעְמֵ֣ק שְׁאָ֔לָה א֖וֹ הַגְבֵּ֥הַּ לְמָֽעְלָה׃

controles.web: “Ask a sign of Yahweh your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”
controles.kjv: Ask thee a sign of the Lord thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
controles.livre: Pede para ti um sinal do SENHOR teu Deus; pede ou de baixo nas profundezas, ou de cima nas alturas.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אָחָ֑ז לֹא־אֶשְׁאַ֥ל וְלֹֽא־אֲנַסֶּ֖ה אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: But Ahaz said, “I will not ask, neither will I tempt Yahweh.”
controles.kjv: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the Lord.
controles.livre: Mas Acaz disse: Não pedirei, nem tentarei ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֖א בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֑ד הַמְעַ֤ט מִכֶּם֙ הַלְא֣וֹת אֲנָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י תַלְא֖וּ גַּ֥ם אֶת־אֱלֹהָֽי׃

controles.web: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?
controles.kjv: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?
controles.livre: Então Isaías disse: Ouvi agora, ó casa de Davi: Achais pouco cansardes aos homens, para cansardes também a paciência do meu Deus?

versos.hebraico: לָ֠כֵן יִתֵּ֨ן אֲדֹנָ֥י ה֛וּא לָכֶ֖ם א֑וֹת הִנֵּ֣ה הָעַלְמָ֗ה הָרָה֙ וְיֹלֶ֣דֶת בֵּ֔ן וְקָרָ֥את שְׁמ֖וֹ עִמָּ֥נוּ אֵֽל׃

controles.web: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
controles.kjv: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
controles.livre: Por isso o Senhor, ele mesmo, vos dará um sinal: eis que a virgem conceberá, e fará nascer um filho, e ela chamará seu nome Emanuel.

versos.hebraico: חֶמְאָ֥ה וּדְבַ֖שׁ יֹאכֵ֑ל לְדַעְתּ֛וֹ מָא֥וֹס בָּרָ֖ע וּבָח֥וֹר בַּטּֽוֹב׃

controles.web: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
controles.kjv: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
controles.livre: Manteiga e mal ele comerá, pois saberá como rejeitar o mal e escolher o bem.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֠י בְּטֶ֨רֶם יֵדַ֥ע הַנַּ֛עַר מָאֹ֥ס בָּרָ֖ע וּבָחֹ֣ר בַּטּ֑וֹב תֵּעָזֵ֤ב הָאֲדָמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתָּ֣ה קָ֔ץ מִפְּנֵ֖י שְׁנֵ֥י מְלָכֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: For before the child knows to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.
controles.kjv: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.
controles.livre: Mas antes que este menino saiba rejeitar o mal e escolher o bem, a terra da qual tendes pavor será desamparada de seus dois reis.

versos.hebraico: יָבִ֨יא יְהוָ֜ה עָלֶ֗יךָ וְעַֽל־עַמְּךָ֮ וְעַל־בֵּ֣ית אָבִיךָ֒ יָמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־בָ֔אוּ לְמִיּ֥וֹם סוּר־אֶפְרַ֖יִם מֵעַ֣ל יְהוּדָ֑ה אֵ֖ת מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃פ

controles.web: Yahweh will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.
controles.kjv: The Lord shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father’s house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.
controles.livre: O SENHOR fará vir sobre ti, sobre o teu povo, e sobre a casa de teu pai, dias que nunca vieram, desde o dia em que Efraim se desviou de Judá, quando vier o rei da Assíria.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִשְׁרֹ֤ק יְהוָה֙ לַזְּב֔וּב אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּקְצֵ֖ה יְאֹרֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלַ֨דְּבוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אַשּֽׁוּר׃

controles.web: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
controles.livre: Porque acontecerá que naquele dia o SENHOR assoviará às moscas que estão na extremidade dos rios do Egito, e às abelhas que andam na terra da Assíria.

versos.hebraico: וּבָ֨אוּ וְנָח֤וּ כֻלָּם֙ בְּנַחֲלֵ֣י הַבַּתּ֔וֹת וּבִנְקִיקֵ֖י הַסְּלָעִ֑ים וּבְכֹל֙ הַנַּ֣עֲצוּצִ֔ים וּבְכֹ֖ל הַנַּהֲלֹלִֽים׃

controles.web: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.
controles.kjv: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.
controles.livre: E virão, e todas elas pousarão nos vales desabitados, e nas fendas das rochas, e em todos os espinheiros, e em todos os arbustos.

versos.hebraico: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֡וּא יְגַלַּ֣ח אֲדֹנָי֩ בְּתַ֨עַר הַשְּׂכִירָ֜ה בְּעֶבְרֵ֤י נָהָר֙ בְּמֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר אֶת־הָרֹ֖אשׁ וְשַׂ֣עַר הָרַגְלָ֑יִם וְגַ֥ם אֶת־הַזָּקָ֖ן תִּסְפֶּֽה׃ס

controles.web: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.
controles.kjv: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired, namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.
controles.livre: Naquele dia o Senhor raspará com uma navalha alugada dalém do rio, por meio do rei da Assíria, a cabeça e os pelos dos pés; e até a barba será tirada por completo.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא יְחַיֶּה־אִ֛ישׁ עֶגְלַ֥ת בָּקָ֖ר וּשְׁתֵּי־צֹֽאן׃

controles.web: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep;
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;
controles.livre: E acontecerá naquele dia, que alguém estará criando uma vaca jovem e duas ovelhas.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֗ה מֵרֹ֛ב עֲשׂ֥וֹת חָלָ֖ב יֹאכַ֣ל חֶמְאָ֑ה כִּֽי־חֶמְאָ֤ה וּדְבַשׁ֙ יֹאכֵ֔ל כָּל־הַנּוֹתָ֖ר בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: and it shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter: for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left in the midst of the land.
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.
controles.livre: E será que, por causa da abundância de leite que lhe derem, ele comerá manteiga; e comerá manteiga e mel todo aquele que for deixado no meio da terra.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יִֽהְיֶ֣ה כָל־מָק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֧ר יִֽהְיֶה־שָּׁ֛ם אֶ֥לֶף גֶּ֖פֶן בְּאֶ֣לֶף כָּ֑סֶף לַשָּׁמִ֥יר וְלַשַּׁ֖יִת יִֽהְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silver shekels, shall be for briers and thorns.
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.
controles.livre: Será também naquele dia, que todo lugar em que antes havia mil videiras do valor de dez mil moedas de prata, se tornará lugar para espinhos e para cardos.

versos.hebraico: בַּחִצִּ֥ים וּבַקֶּ֖שֶׁת יָ֣בוֹא שָׁ֑מָּה כִּי־שָׁמִ֥יר וָשַׁ֖יִת תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה כָל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.
controles.kjv: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.
controles.livre: Que com arco e flechas ali entrarão; porque toda a terra será espinhos e cardos.

versos.hebraico: וְכֹ֣ל הֶהָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּמַּעְדֵּר֙ יֵעָ֣דֵר֔וּן לֹֽא־תָב֣וֹא שָׁ֔מָּה יִרְאַ֖ת שָׁמִ֣יר וָשָׁ֑יִת וְהָיָה֙ לְמִשְׁלַ֣ח שׁ֔וֹר וּלְמִרְמַ֖ס שֶֽׂה׃פ

controles.web: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for the treading of sheep.”
controles.kjv: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.
controles.livre: E também todos os montes onde costumavam ser cavados com enxadas, não se irá a eles por medo dos espinhos e dos cardos; porém servirão para se enviar bois, e para que gado miúdo pise.
